Gravity mode is ready on timsrobot.com. Press **G** and the page collapses.

- **Falling:** the paragraphs, list items, headings, buttons, footer links, the robot and each letter of the neon title fall separately. They tumble, bounce and pile up at the bottom of the screen. Pieces that land on their side stay that way. The neon glow keeps glowing while the letters fall.
- **Grab and throw:** drag any piece and let go while it's moving to fling it. Pieces bounce off the sides of the window. While gravity is on, links don't open when you click them, so you can grab buttons safely.
- **G or Esc again:** everything flies back into place.

**What I checked on the live page:** 38 pieces fell, including 23 title letters. After they settled, none overlapped and none sank below the bottom. I grabbed the robot and threw it with simulated mouse movements: it flew off, hit the left wall and landed on the pile. Clicking "Get it" didn't navigate. After pressing Esc the page was back to normal, and no errors were logged. Your other timsrobot.com mods (living robot, neon title, jelly buttons) still work alongside it. I didn't try it with a real mouse or on a scrolled-down page; only what's on screen when you press G falls.

To undo it, switch off **Gravity mode** in the side panel or ask me to.
